title: CLAUDE.md
text: See design §4. Every user-facing function starts zrd_open() R/source.R: detects compression file’s magic bytes, opens file gzfile() (decompresses everything R writes), wraps connection raw vector zrd_source external pointer, detects kind first decompressed bytes. src/zrd_reader.c R-free buffered reader walk consumes; src/zrd_source.c R side fills R_ReadConnection(). src/zrd_walk.c walk: one frame per open item explicit stack max_depth + 1 frames, step() loop begins next child ends item, BEGIN/END events callback. pairlist’s next cell reuses frame, long pairlists deepen stack; closure’s body, R writes closure cell’s continuation. Bytecode’s structures (ReadBC1, ReadBCLang) flags: get pseudo-frames count limits emit events, call’s cdr reuses frame. src/zrd_walk_r.c runs R walk owned external pointer; R/walk.R maps status condition class. token layer (in_int(), skip_vector(), in_string() src/zrd_walk.c) place three formats differ. src/zrd_trace.c records events (depth, strings inside attributes symbol names) R: zrd_trace() zrd_event_tree() R/trace.R turn table tree, rds_str() renders. src/init.c registers .Call routines exported symbol. Internal C symbols use zrd_ / ZRD_ prefix. walk (src/zrd_walk.c, Stage 2) R-free must compile -DZRD_STANDALONE; data builder (src/zrd_build.c) place R objects made stream content. R-side conditions built R/conditions.R zrd_abort(); class chain lives zrd_condition_classes. Default limits live zrd_default_limits().

what: Invariants that are easy to break
title: CLAUDE.md
text: src/Makevars lists every object hand (portable make) sets $(C_VISIBILITY). new .c file listed silently built; non-static function without hidden visibility fails tools/check-symbols. walk never allocates R object calls R. Anything R-specific goes behind #ifndef ZRD_STANDALONE. Limits checked length file trusted, never . unknown pseudo-type parse error, never skip. R’s codecs fail loudly truncated input: gzfile(), gzip reads short, bzip2 zstd read nothing, xz warns. R/source.R checks gzip trailer’s ISIZE, xz footer empty output, turns codec warnings zurds_decompression_error. Read source bytes zrd_source_call(), codec warning escapes plain warning. Never decompress input memDecompress(): zlib (Linux R without libdeflate) doubles buffer forever truncated gzip, process killed. Compressed raw vectors go temporary file gzfile() instead. Every walk rule cites serialize.c function mirrors (commit a97c000). Keep citation changing rule; Stage 10’s drift check depends . Native routine names R objects namespace (useDynLib .registration = TRUE). R function name .Call routine shadows ; R wrappers use different names (zrd_walk_info() calls zrd_walk_stats). Exported functions pass sys.call() call helpers; internal helpers default call = NULL. Never pass environment: becomes condition’s call prints “Error <environment>”. ASCII mirrors R’s InWord(), consumes white-space character word, InString(), . walk takes trailing newline root item walk ends stream . Gates need canaries: new gate trusted failed planted defect.

title: Conditions raised by zurds — zurds-conditions
text: Every error zurds raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zurds_error.

title: Conditions raised by zurds — zurds-conditions
text: zurds_invalid_argument argument unusable. Carries arg, argument fault. zurds_format_error input file R wrote: bad magic, unknown format character unsupported version. zurds_parse_error stream malformed. Carries offset, byte offset decompressed stream, path, object walk . zurds_unsafe_content file holds something data-reader refuses. Carries findings, rds_scan() report . zurds_not_found name path file. zurds_encoding_error string valid declared encoding. zurds_limit_error limit reached. subclasses zurds_depth_limit, zurds_size_limit zurds_item_limit name one. Carries limit, argument's name, limit_value. zurds_io_error Reading input failed. zurds_decompression_error input decompressed, example truncated.

title: zurds 0.0.0.9000
text: zurds_info() reports package zufast versions, default limits, compressions R can read. rds_info() reads header .rds, .rda serialize() stream, lazy-load database’s index: kind, format, version, writing minimum reading R versions, native encoding compression. rds_str() prints str()-like summary file stream alone, without building object running code. reads XDR, native binary (either byte order) ASCII streams. rds_toc() lists objects .rda file, types, classes, lengths, dimensions, sizes offsets, without building . rds_scan() reports everything file can run code, reach outside , needs package; rds_is_safe() TRUE finds nothing; rds_deps() lists packages file needs. rds_toc() fills risky.
